messages.content: My iron repletion follow-up says my ferritin improved. Can you explain what changed during 2022 using my reports?

Your ferritin rose from 11 ug/L in January to 34 ug/L by August after starting ferrous sulfate every other day in February, with hemoglobin stable around 124–130 g/L throughout. Your mid-luteal progesterone result was 38 nmol/L, which falls within the reference interval of 16–80 nmol/L. The report notes that a single value cannot assess luteal quality. My maternal discharge summary is here. Can you help me review the birth and my recovery using that report?

I can help you review your birth and recovery from the discharge summary. Your delivery was a spontaneous vaginal birth at 39+2 weeks on July 29, with a second-degree tear repaired and a blood loss of 350 mL. Your infant weighed 3320 g with Apgar scores of 8 and 9. For recovery, your hemoglobin was 106 g/L on July 30, and you were advised to continue prenatal vitamins and ferrous sulfate every other day. You should avoid pelvic rest until comfortable and healing is assessed, and seek urgent care for heavy bleeding, fever, chest pain, breathlessness, severe headache, leg swelling, or self-harm thoughts.
